subject: Next steps: identifying fiscal delegate + procurement routing for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@avenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: who signs/owns budget and procurement contact?

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time on today’s call. Quick recap of what we covered and two asks so we can get the procurement path moving: 

Recap
- Aven Health is interested in a 6-week pilot of Redwood inference for internal triage use cases (approx. 100k tokens/day).
- Primary success criteria: 30% reduction in average triage time and <300ms 95th percentile latency for short prompts.
- Security requirements: SOC2 evidence, CSV export controls, and IP network allowlist.

Asks
1) Can you confirm who will be the fiscal/economic approver for this pilot (name + title)? We want to ensure we loop in the right person on budget and PO timing.
2) For procurement/legal routing, please share the correct procurement alias or contact and let us know any vendor forms or security packet owner.

I’ve attached a short SOW draft and our SOC2 summary for your review (attachment stubs below). Proposed next steps: once you confirm names, Ben (cc) can share a tailored commercial one-pager and I can coordinate a short handoff call with your procurement/legal.

Attachments: [SOW-draft-v1.pdf (attachment)], [Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (attachment)]

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0192 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@avenhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: who signs/owns budget and procurement contact?

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear notes and materials. Quick answers below: 

- Fiscal/economic approver: Laura Chen, VP Finance (laura.chen@avenhealth.com). She signs pilots up to $40k; anything above needs the CFO.
- Procurement contact: procurement@avenhealth.com is the correct alias; the day-to-day procurement owner is Mark Patel (mark.patel@avenhealth.com).
- Security owner: I’ll introduce you to our InfoSec lead (cc’d when I have availability) — right now they require a short vendor questionnaire and SOC2 + encryption notes.

Timeline note: Laura prefers to review commercial summaries before procurement loops in; if you can send a single-page cost sketch and the SOW, she’ll confirm whether this sits inside the existing pilot budget this week.

Also: we do need to ensure data egress rules are documented — our security team is sensitive to offsite logging of patient-adjacent data.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Partnerships
Aven Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: (none)
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + ask: who signs/owns budget and procurement contact? — action items

Ben / Monica — forwarding Samantha’s note with next steps. Action items below: 

Ben:
- Can you draft a one-pager cost sketch (annualized and pilot SKU) and a short commercial summary for Laura (VP Finance) — highlight the pilot price, optional scale-path economics, and the PO timeline. Aim for a single page + one slide.
- Also include a clear line for cancellation/no-penalty within the pilot.

Monica (CS):
- Please prep a succinct security summary addressing: SOC2 link (attached), encryption at rest/in transit, data retention options, and egress controls. Keep it top-level (1–2 pages) for initial review.

Timing: if we can get both to me by EOD tomorrow I’ll send to Samantha + Laura so procurement can be pulled in the same day. If Laura indicates this sits within current pilot budget we’ll avoid a formal PO and can proceed with a short agreement; if not, procurement will need a SOW + PO.

Thread attachments: [SOW-draft-v1.pdf], [Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf]

Thanks — I’ll draft an intro to Laura once Ben/Monica confirm the files.

—
Hannah
